Strata's glm_fp4.cu adapts the QPN2 kernel from v100-skinny:
https://github.com/dnv2003/v100-skinny
Revision: 5b589c0dc81223e0ba65bcb3e755874723f8b515
Changes: standalone C++ API, FP32 outputs, Strata stream and format adapters.

The E2M1 shift/rebias decoder derives from LMDeploy / TurboMind,
Copyright OpenMMLab, Apache License 2.0:
https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy
